en.headline: JUPAS offers places to 34.3% of applicants as competition rises
en.dek: Some 15,619 students secured university or subsidised diploma places in the main round, down slightly from last year as total applicants rose 5.3% to 45,545.
body: The Joint University Programmes Admissions System released main-round offer results on Wednesday morning, with about 34.3 per cent of applicants, or 15,619 students, receiving places at UGC-funded universities, Hong Kong Metropolitan University self-financed bachelor programmes or Education University higher diploma courses.

The JUPAS Office said the total number of applicants rose by about 5.3 per cent year on year to 45,545. Of those offered places, 82.64 per cent received one of their top three (Band A) choices. A further 4,979 applicants were offered places under the Study Subsidy Scheme for Designated Professions/Sectors, bringing the overall number of successful applicants to 20,598.

CUHK and HKU each offered places to 12 of the 24 DSE top scorers. CUHK said all 12 of its offers were for medicine programmes, while HKU’s offers spanned medicine, government and law, and business administration and law dual-degree programmes. One top scorer had earlier indicated plans to study computer science at Oxford.
Successful applicants must pay a HK$5,000 acceptance fee by 5pm on Thursday and complete registration procedures with the offering institution within the specified period.

zh.headline: 聯招正式遴選34.3%申請人獲派位 競爭加劇
zh.dek: 15,619名考生獲八大、都大或教大資助高級文憑學額，申請人數按年升5.3%至45,545人，取錄比率較去年微跌。
body: 大學聯合招生辦法周三早上公布正式遴選結果，約34.3%申請人、即15,619人獲派教資會資助學士課程、香港都會大學自資全日制學士學位課程或教育大學教資會資助全日制高級文憑課程。
大學聯招處表示，今屆共有45,545名申請人，按年增加約5.3%。獲派位者中，82.64%取得首三志願（Band A）課程。另有4,979人獲「指定專業／界別課程資助計劃」學額，兩個類別合共20,598人獲派位。
中大及港大各取錄12名文憑試狀元。中大指12名狀元全部入讀醫學院課程；港大取錄的狀元則分別入讀醫科、社會科學及法學雙學位，以及工商管理及法學雙學位課程。一名狀元早前表示計劃赴牛津大學修讀電腦科學。
獲正式遴選取錄資格的申請人須於周四下午5時前繳交5,000元留位費，並按照院校指示於指定期間完成註冊手續。
